# Azion WebKit

> The Vue 3 design system of Azion (`@aziontech/webkit` 5.12.0): components, screen blocks with guidelines, and the design foundations, written for agents that build Azion product, marketing and docs screens.

Start every screen from a block (a reviewed, copyable screen), then fill gaps with components. Import each component from its own subpath (`@aziontech/webkit/<name>`), style only through tokens, and keep strings in the locale catalogs. These pages are generated from `catalog.json`; agents with MCP get the same data from `webkit-mcp` (`search_patterns`, `get_pattern`, `suggest_component`, `get_component`).

Installed copy: `node_modules/@aziontech/webkit/llms/`. Every component also has a JSON API next to its page (`components/<name>.json`).

## Foundations

- [Design tokens](foundations/tokens.md): Every visual decision comes from a token: the token groups, what to use and what lint blocks.
- [Color](foundations/color.md): Semantic color roles, light and dark themes, and the color tokens by group.
- [Typography](foundations/typography.md): The generated typography classes: font, size, line height and tracking in one class.
- [Spacing and layout](foundations/spacing.md): Page levels, the five measures, the two rhythm steps and the spacing scale.
- [Motion](foundations/motion.md): The catalogued animate-* utilities, their timing, when to use each, and reduced motion.
- [Languages (i18n)](foundations/i18n.md): Built-in strings in en, pt-BR and es, the provider, useLocale and locale-aware formatting.
- [Right-to-left](foundations/rtl.md): Logical sides only, so every screen mirrors under dir="rtl"; what mirrors and what does not.
- [Devices](foundations/devices.md): Viewport breakpoints for the shell, container queries for the content, touch targets and reflow at 320 px.
- [Accessibility](foundations/accessibility.md): WCAG 2.1 AA rules every component and screen follows: names, focus, keyboard, contrast, motion.
- [Using WebKit in an app](foundations/usage.md): Start from a block, find a component, import it tree-shakeably, app-level setup and the quality checklist.

## Blocks: Docs

- [DocsArticle (docs/article)](blocks/docs/article.md): One page of the documentation, from the bar to the footer.
- [DocsLanding (docs/landing)](blocks/docs/landing.md): The front door of the documentation.

## Blocks: Headers

- [AuthHeader (headers/auth-header)](blocks/headers/auth-header.md): The top bar of every signed-out and first-run screen: sign in, sign up, password recovery and the onboarding steps.
- [CreationHeader (headers/creation-header)](blocks/headers/creation-header.md): The top bar of the focused creation shell: create, edit and deploy flows that run without the navigation rail.
- [DocsHeader (headers/docs-header)](blocks/headers/docs-header.md): The top bar of the documentation site.
- [ResourceHeader (headers/resource-header)](blocks/headers/resource-header.md): The top bar of every page inside the persistent console shell.
- [SiteHeader (headers/site-header)](blocks/headers/site-header.md): The sticky top bar of the marketing site.

## Blocks: Platform

- [ActivityHistory (platform/account/activity-history)](blocks/platform/account/activity-history.md): The account's audit log.
- [ChangePlanDrawer (platform/account/change-plan-drawer)](blocks/platform/account/change-plan-drawer.md): The drawer the Billing page opens from its Subscription Plan card.
- [ManageResources (platform/account/manage-resources)](blocks/platform/account/manage-resources.md): Where an account admin arranges the account's hierarchy.
- [MfaManagement (platform/account/mfa-management)](blocks/platform/account/mfa-management.md): Multi-factor authentication for a whole account.
- [OnboardingForm (platform/account/onboarding-form)](blocks/platform/account/onboarding-form.md): The `/signup/onboarding` screen, frame included.
- [PaymentMethodCard (platform/account/payment-method-card)](blocks/platform/account/payment-method-card.md): The Payment method card of the Upgrade to Pro drawer.
- [Profile (platform/account/profile)](blocks/platform/account/profile.md): The profile page of a signed-in account, and the layout every account settings page follows.
- [TeamPermissions (platform/account/team-permissions)](blocks/platform/account/team-permissions.md): Who can do what in the account.
- [Tokens (platform/account/tokens)](blocks/platform/account/tokens.md): The Personal tokens page of the account settings.
- [Users (platform/account/users)](blocks/platform/account/users.md): Who can sign in to the account, and through which teams.
- [AiActionApproval (platform/ai/ai-action-approval)](blocks/platform/ai/ai-action-approval.md): The moment an assistant needs permission.
- [AiChat (platform/ai/ai-chat)](blocks/platform/ai/ai-chat.md): A full page where a person talks with the generative AI assistant about their account: they ask in their own words, watch the response arrive, check where it came from, and keep going with a follow-up or a new question.
- [AiChatDrawer (platform/ai/ai-chat-drawer)](blocks/platform/ai/ai-chat-drawer.md): The generative AI assistant beside the work: the reader is on a resource page — here a workload whose error rate is up — and opens the assistant in a drawer to ask about what they see, without losing the page.
- [Auth (platform/auth)](blocks/platform/auth.md): The signed-out screens of a platform app: sign in, sign up, reset password and check your inbox, frame included.
- [CreateHub (platform/create/create-hub)](blocks/platform/create/create-hub.md): The Creation Center, where a new project starts.
- [CreateInDrawer (platform/create/create-in-drawer)](blocks/platform/create/create-in-drawer.md): The right-side drawer that adds or edits something that only exists inside another resource: a domain, a DNS record, an environment, a variable, a rule.
- [DeployDrawer (platform/create/deploy-drawer)](blocks/platform/create/deploy-drawer.md): The drawer a platform deploys from, opened by Deploy on a service or a project.
- [DeployProgressDialog (platform/create/deploy-progress-dialog)](blocks/platform/create/deploy-progress-dialog.md): The modal progress of one deploy that activates several Deployment Settings, each on its own, and the drop-to-deploy confirm that starts it.
- [DeploySuccess (platform/create/deploy-success)](blocks/platform/create/deploy-success.md): The screen a create flow ends on.
- [DeployTemplate (platform/create/deploy-template)](blocks/platform/create/deploy-template.md): A focused page, outside the console shell, where the user turns a template into a running project.
- [DeploymentFlow (platform/create/deployment-flow)](blocks/platform/create/deployment-flow.md): The card a create flow hands its column to once the user has pressed Deploy.
- [MultipageCreate (platform/create/multipage-create)](blocks/platform/create/multipage-create.md): The page a first-level resource is created on one step at a time.
- [ProvisionWizard (platform/create/provision-wizard)](blocks/platform/create/provision-wizard.md): The two-step wizard that provisions a resource bound to another and puts it into traffic.
- [ReleaseImpact (platform/create/release-impact)](blocks/platform/create/release-impact.md): The Review and deploy page of a release that carries several resources at once: a service, the policy in front of it, its storage, its error page and every dependency they reference.
- [ResourcePicker (platform/create/resource-picker)](blocks/platform/create/resource-picker.md): The band a create flow uses when the resource being created needs another resource that may already exist.
- [SinglePageCreate (platform/create/single-page-create)](blocks/platform/create/single-page-create.md): The page a first-level resource is created on when everything it needs fits on one screen.
- [SourceWizard (platform/create/source-wizard)](blocks/platform/create/source-wizard.md): The wizard that starts a resource from code and deploys it.
- [ActivityOutcomesDashboard (platform/dashboard/activity-outcomes-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/activity-outcomes-dashboard.md): The page an operator opens to answer "what did these actors ask for, and what did the rules decide?".
- [AlertsDashboard (platform/dashboard/alerts-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/alerts-dashboard.md): The page a security or operations lead opens to triage: what is open, how severe it is, what kind of alert it is and which entities are involved.
- [AnalyticsDashboard (platform/dashboard/analytics-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/analytics-dashboard.md): The page a developer or operator opens to see how much traffic their services handled and how well they handled it: requests, data transferred, success rate and server errors for the period, then the charts and the ta…
- [CompositionDashboard (platform/dashboard/composition-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/composition-dashboard.md): The page that answers "what is this total made of, and how did the mix move?".
- [ConfigurableDashboard (platform/dashboard/configurable-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/configurable-dashboard.md): A dashboard the reader arranges: they move cards, change how many columns a card spans and how tall it is, and keep that layout.
- [DataDashboard (platform/dashboard/data-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/data-dashboard.md): The usage page: how much the account's projects consumed in the period, how that compares with the previous period, and which projects drove it.
- [ExecutiveSummaryDashboard (platform/dashboard/executive-summary-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/executive-summary-dashboard.md): The one page a lead reads to see how the quarter went: the headline results against last quarter, the twelve-month trend behind each one, progress on the quarter's goals and the notes the leads wrote when they reviewe…
- [FunnelCohortDashboard (platform/dashboard/funnel-cohort-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/funnel-cohort-dashboard.md): The growth page: how people move through the steps from a first visit to a paid plan, where they drop off, and how well each weekly sign-up cohort keeps coming back.
- [HealthScoreDashboard (platform/dashboard/health-score-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/health-score-dashboard.md): The page that answers "how well does this work for the people who use it, and where is it worst?".
- [HomeDashboard (platform/dashboard/home-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/home-dashboard.md): The Console's Home page inside the platform shell: the first screen a signed-in user lands on.
- [ProjectStatusDashboard (platform/dashboard/project-status-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/project-status-dashboard.md): Where one project stands against its plan, one project and sprint at a time.
- [ScanResultsDashboard (platform/dashboard/scan-results-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/scan-results-dashboard.md): The page for a pipeline that sends items (files, attachments, packages) for analysis and gives each a verdict.
- [SecurityDashboard (platform/dashboard/security-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/security-dashboard.md): The page a reader opens to see what their security rules are doing: how many requests were blocked and inspected, how blocking moved over time, which attack categories and countries it came from, which source addresse…
- [ServiceMonitoringDashboard (platform/dashboard/service-monitoring-dashboard)](blocks/platform/dashboard/service-monitoring-dashboard.md): The page an on-call engineer keeps open: is every service up, how fast is it answering, how many requests fail, and which alerts are open right now.
- [DeleteWithConfirmation (platform/delete/delete-with-confirmation)](blocks/platform/delete/delete-with-confirmation.md): The last stop before a resource is gone for good.
- [AttachedResources (platform/detail/attached-resources)](blocks/platform/detail/attached-resources.md): A short list of the things one resource is attached to, shown in place inside its Settings tab.
- [DeploymentLogs (platform/detail/deployment-logs)](blocks/platform/detail/deployment-logs.md): The user started a deployment and wants to know where it is, whether it went live and, when it did not, exactly which step failed and why.
- [DetailsPage (platform/detail/details-page)](blocks/platform/detail/details-page.md): The second-level page of one resource.
- [GetStarted (platform/detail/get-started)](blocks/platform/detail/get-started.md): The first thing a user reads about a resource they created from the CLI and have not deployed yet.
- [ProductionChecklist (platform/detail/production-checklist)](blocks/platform/detail/production-checklist.md): A service that is live on its generated hostname is not yet ready for real traffic.
- [RecordTable (platform/detail/record-table)](blocks/platform/detail/record-table.md): The detail page of a resource that owns a long list of records, here a DNS zone.
- [VersionDetail (platform/detail/version-detail)](blocks/platform/detail/version-detail.md): One version of a resource, opened from its Versions tab.
- [AttributeEditor (platform/edit/attribute-editor)](blocks/platform/edit/attribute-editor.md): A list of key and value pairs and the drawer that edits them, here environment variables.
- [CodeEditor (platform/edit/code-editor)](blocks/platform/edit/code-editor.md): The editing page of a service whose behavior lives in source code.
- [EditResource (platform/edit/edit-resource)](blocks/platform/edit/edit-resource.md): The settings page of one existing resource.
- [RuleBuilder (platform/edit/rule-builder)](blocks/platform/edit/rule-builder.md): A drawer where the user writes one rule of a rules engine: when it runs (the phase), the conditions that decide whether it applies, and the ordered behaviors it performs when they match.
- [SchemaEditor (platform/edit/schema-editor)](blocks/platform/edit/schema-editor.md): The table schema of a SQL database: the definition of one table and the drawers and dialogs that change it.
- [SettingsForm (platform/settings/settings-form)](blocks/platform/settings/settings-form.md): The place the user goes to change how an account or a project behaves.
- [AsyncSubmit (platform/states/async-submit)](blocks/platform/states/async-submit.md): The async-action pattern, taken from the design sample (`/forms/async-deployment`), and the standard for every build and deploy screen.
- [FirstUse (platform/states/first-use)](blocks/platform/states/first-use.md): What a first-level list shows before the account owns any resource of that kind.
- [FormError (platform/states/form-error)](blocks/platform/states/form-error.md): The form-error pattern, taken from the design sample (`/forms/error-validation`): what a long create form does when the server rejects the save because of one section.
- [FormValidation (platform/states/form-validation)](blocks/platform/states/form-validation.md): Every state a submit can land in, on one create form.
- [NotFound (platform/states/not-found)](blocks/platform/states/not-found.md): The page an app renders when it cannot show the address the user asked for: the address leads nowhere (404), the user may not see it (403), or the server failed to build it (500).
- [PageWires (platform/states/page-wires)](blocks/platform/states/page-wires.md): The skeleton wires an app paints while a page is still arriving.
- [ProjectIntake (platform/states/project-intake)](blocks/platform/states/project-intake.md): The surfaces a project passes through when the user drops it on the page.
- [CardView (platform/view/card-view)](blocks/platform/view/card-view.md): The first-level index of one resource type, in cards.
- [FileBrowser (platform/view/file-browser)](blocks/platform/view/file-browser.md): The contents of one storage resource.
- [Marketplace (platform/view/marketplace)](blocks/platform/view/marketplace.md): The page where people find something made by Azion or a partner and add it to what they run.
- [QueryEditor (platform/view/query-editor)](blocks/platform/view/query-editor.md): The workspace of one SQL database.
- [RulesList (platform/view/rules-list)](blocks/platform/view/rules-list.md): An ordered list of rules grouped by phase: the Rules tab of an application (Request and Response phases) or a firewall (Request only).
- [SplitView (platform/view/split-view)](blocks/platform/view/split-view.md): The events explorer.
- [TableView (platform/view/table-view)](blocks/platform/view/table-view.md): The first-level index of one resource type, in rows.
- [TemplateBrowser (platform/view/template-browser)](blocks/platform/view/template-browser.md): The catalog of templates a person starts a project from.
- [WafTuning (platform/view/waf-tuning)](blocks/platform/view/waf-tuning.md): The Tuning tab of a WAF rule set.

## Blocks: Shells

- [Console (shells/console)](blocks/shells/console.md): The application shell every signed-in page renders inside, built on `AppLayout`.
- [Documentation (shells/documentation)](blocks/shells/documentation.md): The documentation shell.
- [Website (shells/website)](blocks/shells/website.md): The marketing shell.

## Components: Actions

- [Button](components/button.md): Interactive control for user actions.
- [ButtonGroup](components/button-group.md): A toolbar of icon actions that belong to one surface (a code panel, a table header, a preview), after Cloudscape's button group.
- [ButtonHighlight](components/button-highlight.md): Visually emphasized action trigger built on a brand-accent gradient with a continuously rotating multicolor glow rim behind the surface (ported from the `azion-console-kit` Copilot button).
- [CopyButton](components/copy-button.md): Icon-only control that copies a string to the clipboard and briefly confirms success.
- [IconButton](components/icon-button.md): Interactive control for user actions.
- [MiniButton](components/mini-button.md): Compact text action with an optional trailing external-link icon and a ghost hover surface.
- [SearchTrigger](components/search-trigger.md): The field-shaped button in a top bar that opens search: a magnifier, a muted label (`Search` by default) and the keycap of the shortcut that opens the same palette (`⌘K` on macOS, `Ctrl K` elsewhere, drawn by `Kbd`).
- [SplitButton](components/split-button.md): A primary command button visually joined to a chevron toggle that opens an overlay menu of related actions defined by a `model` array.
- [ToggleGroup](components/toggle-group.md): ToggleGroup is a connected group of buttons that picks exactly one value out of a small set of related options, with a selection indicator that slides to the active segment.

- [ArtifactPreview](components/artifact-preview.md): A card for something the assistant generated — a file, a code snippet, a table, a configuration (Cloudscape artifact previews, AI Elements Artifact).
- [ChatMessage](components/chat-message.md): One message in a generative AI conversation (Cloudscape's chat bubble, AI Elements' Message): who wrote it (avatar and author line), the content, and — once the response is complete — the inline actions a reader takes…

- [Conversation](components/conversation.md): The scrolling message log of a generative AI chat.
- [ConversationHistory](components/conversation-history.md): The list of past conversations with an assistant, in a side panel or drawer: titles grouped by when they were last active (Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days, Previous 30 days, Older), the open one marked current, and…
- [FeedbackReasonDialog](components/feedback-reason-dialog.md): Asks why an assistant response was not helpful, right after the thumbs-down in `ChatMessage.Feedback`: a small dialog with one required reason (radio buttons) and optional details, then Send feedback.
- [PromptInput](components/prompt-input.md): The composer of a generative AI chat (Cloudscape prompt input, AI Elements PromptInput): a text area that grows with the prompt up to `maxRows`, a Submit control that becomes Stop while a response is being generated,…
- [Reasoning](components/reasoning.md): Shows the model's thinking before its response (Cloudscape Thinking pattern, AI Elements Reasoning): a disclosure whose label reads `Thinking` (pulsing) while the model reasons and `Thought for 14 seconds` once it is…
- [ResponseBranches](components/response-branches.md): Pages through alternative versions of one assistant response: after Regenerate, or when the model returned several candidates, the message shows one version at a time with a `‹ 2 of 3 ›` pager under it.
- [Sources](components/sources.md): The list of sources a generative AI response drew on (Cloudscape's sources expandable section, AI Elements Sources): a disclosure titled `3 sources` that opens an ordered list — number, linked title, one-line descript…
- [StreamingResponse](components/streaming-response.md): Renders a model's Markdown as it streams in (AI Elements Response / Streamdown), safely.
- [SuggestionGroup](components/suggestion-group.md): A group of prompts the reader can send without typing (Cloudscape support prompt group, AI Elements Suggestion): support prompts on an empty conversation, follow-up questions after a response, or the choices of a clar…
- [ToolCall](components/tool-call.md): One tool or command the agent invoked, shown in the conversation (AI Elements Tool, Cloudscape progressive steps): a row with the tool name in code font, an optional plain description, and a status (`Waiting`, `Runnin…

## Components: Charts

- [BarList](components/bar-list.md): A ranked list of named values: each row is a tinted bar whose length is the value against the largest one, with the name inside the bar and the formatted value in a right-aligned column.
- [Chart](components/chart.md): A cartesian chart — lines, areas, stacked areas, bars, mixed bars and lines, and scatter dots over one category axis — composed from parts the consumer places by hand.
- [DonutChart](components/donut-chart.md): A part-to-whole chart drawn as a ring (donut) or a disc (pie): one slice per series, the total in the center, a legend beside it.
- [GaugeChart](components/gauge-chart.md): One reading against a known range, drawn as a half-circle dial with the value under the arc and the scale ends beside it.
- [MapChart](components/map-chart.md): Values by place on the dotted world map of `NetworkMap`: countries shaded on a five-step sequential scale (a choropleth on the dot grid) and locations drawn as bubbles whose area follows the value.
- [SparkChart](components/spark-chart.md): A word-sized chart: one series drawn as an area, a line or bars, with no axes, grid, legend or tooltip, filling the width of its container at a fixed height.
- [StatTile](components/stat-tile.md): A KPI tile: a label, one big figure that counts up into place with an optional muted unit, an optional delta `Tag` against a named period, and an optional sparkline that bleeds to the tile's edges along its bottom.
- [Tracker](components/tracker.md): A status strip: one block per period — a day, an hour, a deployment — colored by its severity, with a readout of the period's label on hover or keyboard focus.

## Components: Code

- [CodeBlock](components/code-block.md): Read-only code viewer for docs, API examples, and configuration previews.
- [CodeEditor](components/code-editor.md): An editable code surface with line numbers, diagnostics and a read-only and a diff mode.
- [LogView](components/log-view.md): Composition-based terminal log viewer for CI/deploy output.
- [Trace](components/trace.md): A span waterfall: one row per span of a run (a function invocation, a request through several services), indented under the span it ran inside and drawn as a bar placed against the run's own clock.

## Components: Content

- [Accordion](components/accordion.md): A vertically stacked set of disclosure items: each item has a clickable header that expands or collapses its content panel.
- [Avatar](components/avatar.md): Displays content or metadata in the UI.
- [Badge](components/badge.md): Badge is a compact, non-interactive indicator that surfaces a numeric count or a very short status label with severity-based color coding.
- [Brand](components/brand.md): The Azion brand logo, rendered as an inline SVG lockup.
- [BrowserFrame](components/browser-frame.md): A browser window that renders live webkit components inside a viewport of its own, so a page or story can show a real screen at a real device size — desktop, tablet or mobile — and resize it by hand.
- [Card](components/card.md): Displays content or metadata in the UI.
- [CardPricing](components/card-pricing.md): One tier of a pricing table: what it is called, what it costs, what that price includes, and the one action that moves the account onto it.
- [Currency](components/currency.md): Typesets one monetary amount as three separately-styled parts — the currency symbol, the figure, and a trailing period or unit — so money reads the same everywhere in the product instead of being a formatted string ea…
- [HelpPanel](components/help-panel.md): The content of a help side region: a topic's title, a few sections of short guidance, and the "Learn more" links that leave for the documentation — or, in tutorial mode, an ordered list of tasks with the reader's prog…
- [Hotspot](components/hotspot.md): Marks a real control as a step of a tutorial.
- [Illustration](components/illustration.md): Renders an **official product illustration** — one of the scenes drawn in the Assets library in Figma and exported as an SVG that ships with this package.
- [Item](components/item.md): Versatile flex row for title, description, media, and actions.
- [Kbd](components/kbd.md): Kbd renders keyboard input — a single key or a shortcut combination — as a compact, non-interactive keycap.
- [KeyValuePairs](components/key-value-pairs.md): A grid of labelled facts about one subject: each pair is a key (the term) and its value, which may be plain text or a composed component such as a `Link`, `Tag`, `CopyButton` or `StatusIndicator`.
- [LineFigure](components/line-figure.md): An isometric line-art figure that answers the pointer: one per product (cache TTL, load balancer, DNS lookup, firewall, a 404 page and 20 more), drawn by a small engine into one SVG with the illustration tokens, so it…
- [NetworkMap](components/network-map.md): A decorative, full-bleed layer that paints the dotted world map with Azion's PoPs lit in the brand accent.
- [OverflowCount](components/overflow-count.md): A small `+N` chip that stands for the items a slot cannot show, and opens a popover with the whole list.
- [Overline](components/overline.md): Overline is the short uppercase label set above a headline to name the section, panel or group it opens (the "eyebrow").
- [PaymentBrand](components/payment-brand.md): The card-brand plate shown beside a payment card: a small bordered plate with the network's mark (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Diners Club, JCB, Discover, Elo, Hipercard, UnionPay) drawn in one colour in theme…
- [ProductWidget](components/product-widget.md): Draws one of the **official console widgets**: a scaled, inert mock of an Azion Console screen or fragment, built from real webkit components inside a `shell-mockup` frame, that marketing bands use to show the product.
- [QrCode](components/qr-code.md): A QR code drawn as SVG from a string, with no image request and no dependency: WebKit's own encoder (byte mode, UTF-8, versions 1–40, error correction L/M/Q/H) turns the value into modules, and the component draws the…
- [SeverityTag](components/severity-tag.md): SeverityTag labels an item with its place on an ordered severity scale: critical, high, medium, low or info.
- [ShellMockup](components/shell-mockup.md): A scaled, inert picture of an Azion Console screen, for marketing bands that show the product.
- [Tag](components/tag.md): Compact status or category label with severity-based color coding.
- [TutorialPanel](components/tutorial-panel.md): The guide that runs tutorials beside the real product.

## Components: Data

- [Cards](components/cards.md): A collection shown as cards, after Cloudscape's cards: one card per item, named by its `header` slot, with the item's fields in the default slot.
- [CollectionPreferences](components/collection-preferences.md): The preferences panel of a collection, after Cloudscape's collection preferences: a cog button opens a dialog (or a drawer) with the page size, the columns (shown, hidden and ordered; a locked column always shows), wr…
- [Flow](components/flow.md): Flow renders a directed flow diagram: a horizontal sequence of steps (`flow-node`) joined by decorative connectors, with optional parallel branches (`flow-parallel`) and custom connector-attachment points (`flow-ancho…
- [Pagination](components/pagination.md): Pagination controls for tables and lists, pixel-perfect to Figma, in two modes.
- [PickList](components/pick-list.md): Dual-list transfer control: a labelled **source** listbox and a labelled **target** listbox with a control column to move items between them.
- [PropertyFilter](components/property-filter.md): One field that filters a collection by properties and free text, after Cloudscape's property filter.
- [Table](components/table.md): Composition primitives for building accessible, pixel-perfect data tables, in two modes.
- [TopologyDiagram](components/topology-diagram.md): The deployment topology of a resource as a left-to-right diagram: each column is a depth (domains, project, policy, service, cache rules, integration, storage), each node a collapsible card with the resource kind, its…
- [Tree](components/tree.md): A hierarchical list of nodes, each row a name with an optional glyph and one line of detail, where a parent row folds its children open and closed under a chevron.

## Components: Documentation

- [DocAccordionGroup](components/doc-accordion-group.md): The FAQ and "expand for detail" block of a documentation page.
- [DocAccordionItem](components/doc-accordion-item.md): One collapsible entry inside a `DocAccordionGroup`.
- [DocCallout](components/doc-callout.md): The admonition a documentation page interrupts itself with — Note, Info, Tip, Check, Warning, Danger — rendered on the webkit `Alert` surface, so the severity colour, the border, the icon and the radius come from the…
- [DocCard](components/doc-card.md): One cell of the grid a documentation page scans across: a leading glyph, an optional eyebrow, the title, the copy, and an optional call-to-action row at the foot.
- [DocCardGroup](components/doc-card-group.md): The framed, responsive grid a `DocCard` set sits in.
- [DocCodeGroup](components/doc-code-group.md): One or more code samples of the same thing in different languages or package managers, rendered on `CodeBlock` so the docs inherit its header, copy control and syntax surface.
- [DocCta](components/doc-cta.md): The closing offer of a documentation page, parked at the foot of the "On this page" rail after the outline.
- [DocFrame](components/doc-frame.md): The bordered surface every screenshot, diagram and clip in a documentation page sits on, so no media floats loose on the canvas and all of it shares one border, radius and inset.
- [DocHeading](components/doc-heading.md): A documentation section heading that is also the link to itself.
- [DocItem](components/doc-item.md): One row of the documentation's related-content list: a leading glyph in a framed 32px tile, the row's name, and the sentence that says what the thing is.
- [DocOnThisPage](components/doc-on-this-page.md): The "On this page" rail: the page's own headings, the active one lit, nested headings indented under their parent — followed by the rail's complementary groups (the repository, the community).
- [DocPageHeader](components/doc-page-header.md): The masthead of a documentation page: where the reader is (the breadcrumb), what the page is (the title), what they can do with it (a Copy Page control that hands the page to an AI tool — or, through the `actions` slo…
- [DocPagination](components/doc-pagination.md): The previous / next pair that closes a documentation page.
- [DocPrompt](components/doc-prompt.md): DocPrompt renders text the reader is meant to **run, not read** — the block a documentation page uses when the next step is "say this to your agent".
- [DocProse](components/doc-prose.md): The typography contract every documentation page inherits.
- [DocStep](components/doc-step.md): One numbered step of a `DocSteps` walkthrough: the circled index, the rail that continues to the next step, the step heading, and any content the author nests underneath.
- [DocSteps](components/doc-steps.md): The ordered walkthrough from the docs frame: a column of `DocStep` children joined by a rail.
- [DocTab](components/doc-tab.md): One panel inside `DocTabs`.
- [DocTabs](components/doc-tabs.md): Alternative paths through the same instruction ("macOS / Linux / Windows", "Console / CLI").
- [DocTooltip](components/doc-tooltip.md): The inline gloss: a term in running prose that carries its own definition, shown when the reader hovers or focuses it.
- [DocUpdate](components/doc-update.md): One entry in a changelog: what shipped, when, and under which version.

## Components: Feedback

- [Alert](components/alert.md): Inline feedback banner that communicates status, alerts, or progress.
- [EmptyState](components/empty-state.md): Centered placeholder shown when a resource list or section has no content yet.
- [ErrorBoundary](components/error-boundary.md): Guards one region of a page.
- [OutcomeMark](components/outcome-mark.md): A small round mark that states how something ended: a check for success, a cross for danger, an exclamation for warning and a dash for neutral (not set, not run).
- [Progress](components/progress.md): Communicates the progress of an ongoing task as a horizontal bar.
- [Skeleton](components/skeleton.md): A loading placeholder that reserves the space of content while it loads, gently pulsing to signal activity.
- [StatusIndicator](components/status-indicator.md): Communicates status, alerts, or progress to the user.
- [Toast](components/toast.md): A transient, non-blocking notification system: mount the `<Toaster>` region **once** near the application root, then raise notifications imperatively from anywhere via the exported `toast()` function (`toast('Saved')`…
- [UploadProgress](components/upload-progress.md): A card that follows a file transfer to its end while the person keeps working: uploading files into a bucket, moving objects between folders or deleting them.

## Components: Inputs

- [AttributeEditor](components/attribute-editor.md): An editable list of rows with the same fields, after Cloudscape's attribute editor: key and value pairs (environment variables, headers, metadata) or any set of columns given by a `definition`.
- [Calendar](components/calendar.md): Date-range picker.
- [Checkbox](components/checkbox.md): Binary selection control.
- [Chip](components/chip.md): A Chip is a compact, pill-shaped token that labels a discrete value the user has applied — most often a filter on a data view.
- [Combobox](components/combobox.md): A text field with a list of suggestions under it: typing filters the options, picking one fills the field, and a value that is not in the list is accepted as typed.
- [DateRangePicker](components/date-range-picker.md): A time range for queries over time: logs, events, traces and metrics.
- [Field](components/field.md): One composable form field that wraps **any** control — `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `MultiSelect`, `NumberInput`, `PasswordInput`, `PhoneInput`, `InputGroup`, `Checkbox`, `RadioButton`, `Switch`, `Slider` — with its…
- [FileDropzone](components/file-dropzone.md): A FileDropzone is the target a user drags files from the operating system onto.
- [FileTokenGroup](components/file-token-group.md): The files a person picked for upload, shown as removable tokens before or while they upload: each token names the file with a glyph for its type, its size and, when asked, its last-modified date, carries a progress ba…
- [HelperText](components/helper-text.md): Auxiliary text rendered below a form input to communicate guidance (`helper`), validation errors (`invalid`), required-field reminders (`required`), or a locked/disabled state (`disabled`).
- [Hint](components/hint.md): Small info affordance — a muted `pi pi-info-circle` glyph on a focusable button — that reveals one short explanation on hover or focus, through `Tooltip`.
- [Input](components/input.md): Single-line text input for forms and inline editing.
- [InputGroup](components/input-group.md): Composition container that joins an input primitive with any number of adjacent controls (buttons, selects, static addons) into a single visual field — the webkit analogue of PrimeVue's `InputGroup`.
- [Label](components/label.md): Form-field label that pairs descriptive text with an optional required indicator and an optional hint.
- [MultiSelect](components/multi-select.md): Select control specialised for choosing many options from a list.
- [NumberInput](components/number-input.md): Numeric input field with optional increment/decrement spinner buttons.
- [OtpInput](components/otp-input.md): The field for a one-time code: the six digits an authenticator app shows, or a code sent by email or SMS.
- [PasswordInput](components/password-input.md): Single-line password input for forms.
- [PasswordRequirements](components/password-requirements.md): Live checklist of password rules shown under a `PasswordInput`: a caption followed by one chip per rule, each chip turning to the success tone with a check as the typed value satisfies it.
- [PhoneInput](components/phone-input.md): International phone-number control: an `InputGroup` with a searchable dial-code `Select` on the left and a `type="tel"` input on the right that applies the selected country's mask as the user types and accepts exactly…
- [RadioButton](components/radio-button.md): Atomic exclusive-choice control only — the circular radio input from Figma (no label, description, or helper).
- [RadioCards](components/radio-cards.md): Horizontal grid of selectable cards for mutually exclusive choices (plans, roles, feature tiers).
- [SchemaForm](components/schema-form.md): A form rendered from a JSON schema: each property of an object schema becomes a `Field` with its label, description, Required marker and control, and a nested object becomes a fieldset with its own legend.
- [Select](components/select.md): Select control for choosing one (`multiple={false}`) or many (`multiple={true}`) options from a list.
- [Slider](components/slider.md): Bare range control `Slider`: one thumb on a horizontal track that picks a single number between `min` and `max` in `step` increments, with the portion from `min` to the value filled.
- [Switch](components/switch.md): Control-only pill toggle `Switch` (36×20 px).
- [TagEditor](components/tag-editor.md): Key and value tags of one resource, after Cloudscape's tag editor, built on `AttributeEditor`.
- [Textarea](components/textarea.md): Collects multi-line free-form text from the user.
- [ThemeSwitcher](components/theme-switcher.md): A compact pill-shaped segmented control that lets the user pick the app color-theme mode — `system`, `dark`, or `light` — via three icon-only segments.

## Components: Layout

- [AppLayout](components/app-layout.md): The frame every signed-in product page renders inside.
- [Board](components/board.md): A configurable dashboard grid: the reader arranges the cards.
- [Footer](components/footer.md): Page footer for marketing and product surfaces: the bottom-of-page counterpart to `GlobalHeader`.
- [FrameBox](components/frame-box.md): The registration frame: a hairline box with a small square set inside each corner and an optional linear hatch texture behind its content.

- [PageHeader](components/page-header.md): The heading that opens a console page: an h1 whose `size` picks the heading token by page level, a one-line description, and the actions the page owns on the right.
- [Resizable](components/resizable.md): A group of adjacent regions whose shared edges the reader can drag.
- [SaveBar](components/save-bar.md): The bar at the bottom of a settings or create page that holds the status of unsaved work and its Discard (or Cancel) and Save actions.
- [ScrollArea](components/scroll-area.md): Structural layout primitive for scrolling regions: native overflow with themed thin scrollbars and keyboard scrolling.
- [SectionHeader](components/section-header.md): The heading of one band inside a page: an h2 with a one-line description, a copy-link button that appears when the heading is hovered or focused (when it has an `anchor`), and the band's own actions on the right.
- [Separator](components/separator.md): Thin separator line that visually splits content into groups.
- [SettingRow](components/setting-row.md): One setting inside a flush `Card`: an `Item` whose content carries the title and description, with the control placed by what it needs.
- [SettingsSection](components/settings-section.md): A band of a settings page: an h2 with a `Hint` glyph that carries the one-sentence guidance, over the band body (usually a flush `Card` of `SettingRow` rows).
- [Sidebar](components/sidebar.md): Helps users move between views or sections.

- [UseCaseLinks](components/use-case-links.md): The use-case directory band of a solution page: a left-aligned section title over a divider grid of linked topics, one per use case, each an icon, a heading and a sentence that link to the page that explains it.
- [UseCases](components/use-cases.md): The "what teams use it for" band of a product page: a three-column frame whose first cell carries the band's overline, headline, lead and one call to action, followed by one cell per use case.

## Components: Utilities

- [Spinner](components/spinner.md): Shared visual utility used by other components.
- [WebkitProvider](components/webkit-provider.md): Sets the language and text direction of every WebKit component below it.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every foundation, block and component page in one file, sized for one context window: block guidelines without their code and the first example of each component (the pages above hold the code and every example).
- [catalog.json](../catalog.json): the machine catalog the pages are generated from (exports, props, tokens, blocks).
